title: A generator on the descended marked fibre
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Assume that for every base change $T\to S$, the canonical structure-module adjunction unit for the second projection is an isomorphism [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-module-pullback, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $L$ be invertible on $X$ [def-sc-invertible-module], $k:W\to S$ an immersion, and $w\in W$, $s\in S$ with $k(w)=s$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Suppose that the pullback of $L$ to $X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ is isomorphic to the pullback of a finite locally free module on $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. On $Y=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(w)$, using the map $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(w)\to W\to S$, there exists a global section $\tau$ of the pullback of $L$ which generates at every point of $Y$: around each point its restriction is a free generator [def-sc-section-generating-locus, def-sc-local-free-generator].

source.place: Tag 0BF2, proof after replacing S by the intersection, through d = 0 and lifting the fibre generator; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BF2

proof.text: Identify the residue fields at w and s via the immersion. Transport the finite locally free fibre descent isomorphism. Universal structure pushforward makes the fibre morphism surjective, so invertibility of the pullback forces the descended module to have rank one over the residue field. Choose its basis and transport its pullback through the descent isomorphism; it is a free generator at every fibre point.

theorem picard_h1_base_descent_fibre_generator {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) [IsImmersion k]
    (w : W) (s : S) (hw : k w = s)
    (hLs : ∃ (N : (Spec (S.residueField s)).Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree),
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj L ≅
        (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj N)) :
    ∃ τ : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback
      (pullback.fst f (W.fromSpecResidueField w ≫ k))).obj L, ⊤),
      ∀ y : (pullback f (W.fromSpecResidueField w ≫ k) : Scheme.{v}),
        Modules.GeneratesAt τ y
